name: Lakeville Fall Scramble
oneLiner: Ten weeks from early October to just before Christmas, with Monday and Thursday nights pooled into one eight-team field so you were always playing somebody.
beginnerNote: A scramble is the friendliest format there is: both of you hit, you take the better ball and go again from there. Nobody has to card a bad hole on their own.
prizes: Top 4 teams played off for 1st, 2nd and 3rd
nextSeasonNote: This is how it ran before. The 2026 fall lineup is published and open for registration.
